title: Understanding the Connection Between Sleep Apnea and Heart Disease
description: Approximately 15 per cent of the general population suffer from sleep apnea, affecting patients on a day-to-day basis by reducing sleep quality and resulting in daytime sleepiness, decreased cognitive function, and impaired functional capacity.
